messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: kv-service fallthrough rate spiked to 6.2% in us-west-1 (p95 latency up). Pager routed to @sam. https://ops.redwood/alerts/kv-fallthrough

sam: I'm oncall and joining the bridge now — joining https://meet.redwood/bridge/kv-2236004871

marta: I'll standby for customer comms. Do we know impact surface?

sam: Initial read: elevated error/fallbacks hitting the embeddings path. Some customers reported intermittent 502s; no full region outage so far.

jing: quick log dump: lots of entries like:
```
ERROR kv: key_normalize failed: invalid_char 0x00, request_id=abc123, route=embed
stack: kv/normalize.go:89
```
looks correlated with the canary we rolled an hour ago (feature/kv-key-normalize).

ethan: I can unwind the canary to the previous revision (r7). Command I will run: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/kv-service --to-revision=7 -n prod`

sam: go for it — coordinate with infra, echo status here.

ops-bot: EXEC: starting rollout undo for deployment/kv-service in prod (initiated by ethan)

ethan: rollback started — watching pods come up

ops-bot: EXEC: rollout undo completed (revision 7). New pods healthy.

sam: Monitoring metrics — fallthrough rate dropping, errors reducing. Good catch. I'll keep the bridge open for 15 more minutes and then hand off.

marta: Drafted a short customer note for affected tenants, will wait till we confirm stability.

jing: root cause hypothesis: key-normalize change rejects some legacy keys (nulls/odd bytes) which triggered fallback to slower path and some downstream 502s. Need unit tests for legacy key shapes.

sam: Agreed. Let's capture action items and schedule a postmortem. Who can take notes? I will create the doc.

marta: I'm available Thu 2025-03-20 16:00 UTC for postmortem. Prefer virtual.

jing: Thu works for me as well.

sam: Proposed postmortem time Thu 2025-03-20 16:00 UTC. I'll send calendar invite.

jing: Alert tuning note: current alert rule fires on >1% fallthrough over 5m. That made it noisy for short canary blips. Proposal:
```yaml
alert: KVFallthroughHigh
expr: increase(kv_fallthrough_rate[10m]) > 0.02 # 2% sustained over 10m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "kv fallthrough >2% for 10m (possible customer impact)"
```
Also add a secondary `warning` alert at 0.8% for 15m so we don't page on transient spikes.

marta: Also recommend adding a customer-impact label in the alert pipeline and a dashboard panel showing errors-by-tenant to speed triage.

sam: Action items (quick):
- [x] rollback/revert canary — owner: ethan — done
- [ ] postmortem doc & timeline — owner: sam — due: 3d
- [ ] alert rewrite (2%/10m + 0.8%/15m warning) — owner: jing — due: 24h
- [ ] add tenant-error dashboard + runbook links — owner: marta — due: 7d
- [ ] unit tests for legacy key shapes + CI gate on canary — owner: jing/eng-runtime — due: 14d

ops-bot: NOTE: postmortem doc created: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/kv-fallthrough-2236004871 (assigned to sam)

sam: I'll add timeline, root cause steps, and fill owners.

marta: I'll send customer comms after the postmortem is drafted, and loop in account teams for affected tenants.

jing: I'll push alert rule PR and include example Grafana panel config. Preview command: `kubectl apply -f alert-kv-fallthrough.yaml --dry-run=client`

sam: Thanks everyone. Bridge clear in 10 unless anything else shows up. Leaving follow-ups in the doc.

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled postmortem meeting created for 2025-03-20T16:00:00Z (invite sent to sam, jing, marta, ethan)

marta: Closing notes: consider adding a canary-metrics check to gate key-normalize changes (synthetic legacy keys). Adding to action list. :white_check_mark:
